sections.text: Historical outcomes were poor, but durable molecular remissions were documented after CD19-directed immunotherapy and transplantation in a small retrospective cohort.

sections.text: Blinatumomab followed by transplantation produced sustained molecular remissions in several patients in a small TCF3::HLF-positive B-ALL series. This is clinical series evidence, not an HLF-specific drug indication.

audit_evidence.scope: Actual blinatumomab/HSCT outcomes; not randomized evidence.

report_comment.text: TCF3 encodes E2A transcription factors required for lymphoid development. HLF encodes a PAR-bZIP transcription factor that binds sequence-specific promoter elements. TCF3::HLF defines a rare B-ALL subtype with pronounced resistance to conventional chemotherapy. Historical outcomes were poor, but durable molecular remissions were documented after CD19-directed immunotherapy and transplantation in a small retrospective cohort. Blinatumomab followed by transplantation produced sustained molecular remissions in several patients in a small TCF3::HLF-positive B-ALL series. This is clinical series evidence, not an HLF-specific drug indication.
